text:
alice_sales: Greenfield Insurance POC kickoff tomorrow. They need: low-latency streaming (WS preferred), function/tool-calling for claims extraction, strict JSON schema outputs, SAML SSO + customer-managed KMS, and a procurement-ballpark for reserved capacity vs hosted autoscale. Can eng deliver runnable samples in 48h and a short perf summary?

dan_engineer: We can get a minimal Node WS stream + Python SSE sample out in 48h. Will include a small replay driver to approximate steady 1k qps and measure p50/p95. Demo handshake for WS:```js
const ws = new WebSocket('wss://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=redwood-2');
ws.on('open', () => ws.send(JSON.stringify({input:'extract_claim', stream:true})));
ws.on('message', m => console.log('msg', m));
```
I'll also add a sample showing tool/function calls returning structured objects.

priya_se: For structured output we should use function calls with an explicit JSON Schema and a live validator. Example expected function payload (stringified for demo): ```json
{"tool":"extract_claim","args":{"claim_id":"string","amount":{"type":"number","currency":"USD"},"accident_date":"string"}}
```
Show a 422-style error when the model returns the wrong type: `{"error":{"code":"SCHEMA_MISMATCH","path":"/args/amount","received":"string"}}`.

dan_engineer: Ops notes: recommend reserved small pool for consistent tail latencies. Batching window 10-25ms hits a good cost/latency sweet spot. Fallback policy: route overflow to cheaper model variant with header `x-redwood-fallback: true` so app can decide. Auth: SAML for console, ephemeral API tokens (STS) for SDKs; TTL configurable 15m-1h. KMS: we support AWS/GCP/Azure CMKs and HSM attestations.

theo_ops: I'll provision a sandbox cluster with AWS CMK for the demo once samples land. Need the replay script by EOD to run perf tests. I'll also enable reserved capacity sandbox: reserved-greenfield-01.

alice_sales: Procurement needs a short monthly delta. Dan any quick ballpark? Keep it simple — we don't need full calc yet.

dan_engineer: Very rough ballpark: dedicated small pool (~4x A100 equiv) for 1k qps text gen ~ "\$33k/mo"; hosted autoscale with batching and prefix caching ~ "\$20k/mo". I'll produce a token-based calc tomorrow with sample prompts and average tokens.

lucy_legal: Send security questionnaire to me (lucy_legal). Upload link for Greenfield: https://onetrust.example.com/greenfield-upload. They asked for SOC2, KMS key policy, and data residency. I'll attach the standard security packet and a short FAQ about KMS integration.

infra_bot: docs: Streaming SDKs -> https://docs.redwood.ai/streaming  |  Tool/Function calls -> https://docs.redwood.ai/tool-calls  |  KMS integration -> https://docs.redwood.ai/kms-integration

priya_se: Demo tip: show a small web UI that validates the returned JSON against schema and highlights field errors. Also demo automatic corrective prompt flow where client sends back a tightened schema or explicit field hint when missing. Example fallback error payload: `{"result":null,"errors":[{"code":"MISSING_FIELD","field":"accident_date"}]}`.

theo_ops: Timeline: collect Greenfield sample prompts this afternoon, run replay and perf tomorrow morning, live demo 2pm PT. I'll open a ticket with infra if we hit capacity.

alice_sales: Great. I'll ask Greenfield to share sample claim examples and security contact now. @lucy_legal I'll send the NDA. :thumbsup:

dan_engineer: Small routing + batching snippet we'll demo (YAML):```yaml
route_policy:
  - match: traffic.high
    capacity: reserved:greenfield-01
    fallback: redwood-lite
batching:
  max_delay_ms: 20
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  prefix_cache: true
```

alice_sales: Thanks everyone. Ping me immediately if any blocker shows up. I'll update the Greenfield deck with these points and the cost slide.
